text: Tell me about a time you had a conflict with a teammate and how you resolved it.

How do you keep your technical skills up to date?

Explain how database indexes work and when they can hurt performance.
What is the difference between REST and GraphQL, and what are the trade-offs?
How would you design a URL shortening service that handles 100 million links?
Design a notification system that can send millions of push notifications per hour.
Write a function that checks whether a string containing brackets is balanced.
How would you reverse a singly linked list, and what is the time complexity?
Given an array of integers, how would you find two numbers that add up to a target value?
Tell me about yourself.
Walk me through your background and what brought you to this role.
